videos.description: Allied troops gain back the territory they lost in the Battle of the Bulge by Spring 1945.

videos.title: The War
videos.description: In the Pacific, Americans are fighting on the island of Okinawa, gateway to Japan. Meanwhile, in Europe, allied forces rapidly push across Germany from the East and West, and discover the true horrors of the Nazi's industrialized barbarism, at Buchenwald, Dachau, Mauthausen and hundreds of other concentration camps. Finally, on May 8th, with their country in ruins and their Fuehrer dead by his own hand, the Germans surrender.

videos.title: Inside Japan's War
videos.description: The political structures of the Japanese Empire allow the military to operate outside the control of the civilian government. This leads to the invasion of Manchuria, and a new view of Japan's destiny emerges.

videos.title: Inside Japan's War
videos.description: After the successful attack on Pearl Harbour, the Japanese army begins a widespread assault throughout Asia. The war successes accumulate, Malaysia and Singapore are conquered, then the Philippines and Burma.

videos.title: Inside Japan's War
videos.description: In the Japanese-occupied territories, the military rules with extreme harshness. Countless atrocities are committed against the civilian population, but also against prisoners of war. Meanwhile, doubts are growing among the Japanese population.

videos.title: Inside Japan's War
videos.description: The overwhelming superiority of the Allies becomes increasingly apparent and comes to its climax in August 1945 with the atomic bombing of the two cities Hiroshima and Nagasaki. This action leads to the surrender of Japan.

videos.title: Grand Tours of the Scottish Islands
videos.description: This tour sees Paul go diving at Scotland's first scallop ranch, kayak to the Summer Isles, and visit the eerie but beautiful Island of Gruinard which was once considered to be so solitary and remote, it was chosen to be the testing ground for Britain's biological warfare experiments during World War II.

videos.title: Spy Ops
videos.description: Just 15 days after Sept. 11, 2001, CIA operatives land in Afghanistan with suitcases full of cash and a mission to dismantle the Taliban.

videos.title: Vikings: The Making of an Empire
videos.description: When his father died in 958, the Danish king Harald Bluetooth inherited a divided pagan kingdom threatened by the empire of Otto I. He decided to convert his people.

videos.title: Vikings: The Making of an Empire
videos.description: King Harald Bluetooth converted his people and thus established his power among the Danes. But archaeologists reveal that the king was also a social and political strategist far ahead of his time.
